title: 第21章 太湖
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰站在客厅中，又测试了一下自己这个感知天赋。

    最大范围是周身三米，但感知很模糊，而若是将这种能力凝聚，可以集中到身周一米范围内的细微动静。

    “三四米……范围不大，但够用了。”

    陈峰睁开眼睛，心中很是满意。

    这种感知能力的作用显然极大，最起码往后那些大墟世界的异种生物，不可能再躲在暗处偷袭他了。

    陈峰正琢磨着，

    这时，他的目光扫过不远处的茶几上摆放着的几株血根草，突然微微一顿。

    嗯？

    他此刻能够清晰的感知到，那几株血根草中蕴藏的灵气。

    而且，似乎还能察觉到这几株血根草中的灵气走向？

    陈峰微微一愣，随即走到茶几前伸手拿起一株血根草，集中注意力观察。

    很快便清晰的感知到，灵气在血根草的茎秆和根系之间来回涌动。

    “这个天赋，对灵气的感知能力也有加成……”

    “等等。”

    陈峰愣了一下，随即反应过来，灵药调制！

    之前他调制血根草药剂的时候，最大的问题就在于判断灵气的涌动方向，全靠经验判断，稍微走神就前功尽弃。

    但现在有了这个感知天赋……

    他立刻动手，从冰箱里取出铁鄂灰蜚心脏，将其切下薄薄一片。

    又拿起这株幼年期血根草，洗净，分别放入研磨器中碾碎，准备好辅料、器皿和清水，随后开始调制。

    首先，将血根草碎末倒入清水，而碎末接触清水的一瞬间，灵气开始涌动。

    以前这个过程，他只能隐约感觉到一点变化，而现在却非常清晰的感知到灵气从血根草的纤维中析出，向液体中央汇聚。

    陈峰伸出手指悬在瓶口上方，借助感知能力，能够清晰察觉到灵气汇聚的节点。

    等到这股灵气涌动到巅峰的那一刹，他便立刻将提前处理好的心脏脂质溶液注入。

    时机刚好，灵气被脂质中的活性成分包裹中和，翻涌瞬间平息。

    药液的颜色从浑浊转为清澈的淡红，比之前调制的那几瓶还要透亮几分。

    整个过程非常丝滑。

    以前需要屏息凝神，全力以赴才能完成的操作，在此刻却是轻而易举的完成了。

    陈峰拿起药瓶，微微抿了一小口。

    药液入喉，温润绵长，比之前调的那些药剂更加柔和，吸收速度也更快。

    “果然……”

    他放下瓶子，心头火热。

    灵药师这个专业，入门门槛高，核心就在于对灵气流动的感知。

    普通灵药师只能靠经验积累，一次次试错，慢慢摸索规律。

    只有修行到了极高的境界，精神力强大之后，才能真正看到灵气的流向。

    而陈峰现在，拥有了感知天赋之后，便直接跳过了这个过程。

    有了这个天赋之后，灵药学的学习速度恐怕能翻几倍，说不定用不了多久，就能成功调制出真正的一级药剂……

    陈峰忍不住咧嘴笑了笑。

    兴奋了好一会儿之后，便把这个念头暂时压下。

    他转身坐回桌前，从个人空间中取出那几本从武馆中得到的武学笔记，翻开来看了看。

    字迹各不相同，有的工整，有的潦草，但共同的问题是太零散了。

    而且每个学员记录的侧重点不同。

    有的写了桩功要领，却没写配套的呼吸诀窍，有的记了招式名称和动作，却没有对应的发力路径。

    硬啃的话，不知道要啃到猴年马月。

    陈峰把笔记合上，靠在椅背上想了想，随后打开手机，看了一眼银行APP。

    这段时间白鱼上又卖出去几株血根草，加上之前周柔姐给的一万块现金，账户余额一万两千。

    他犹豫了几秒，打开电脑浏览器，搜索了一个关键词。
content_en:
Chen Feng stood in the living room and tested his perception talent again.

    The maximum range is three meters around the body, but the perception is very vague. If this ability is condensed, it can focus on the subtle movements within one meter of the body.

    "Three to four meters...the range is not large, but it is enough."

    Chen Feng opened his eyes, feeling very satisfied.

    This kind of perception is obviously very useful. At least in the future, the alien creatures from the Great Ruins World will no longer be able to hide in the dark and sneak attack on him.

    Chen Feng was thinking about it,

    At this time, his eyes glanced at several bloodroot plants placed on the coffee table not far away, and he suddenly paused slightly.

    Um?

    At this moment, he could clearly sense the spiritual energy contained in those bloodroot grasses.

    Moreover, it seems that you can still detect the direction of the spiritual energy in these bloodroot grasses?

    Chen Feng was stunned for a moment, then walked to the coffee table, reached out and picked up a bloodroot, and concentrated on observing it.

    Soon, it was clearly felt that spiritual energy was flowing back and forth between the stems and roots of the bloodroot.

    "This talent also increases the ability to perceive spiritual energy..."

    "Wait."

    Chen Feng was stunned for a moment, then realized what he was doing and prepared the elixir!

    When he was preparing the blood root herbal medicine before, the biggest problem was to judge the direction of the spiritual energy surge. He relied on experience to judge. If he was distracted for a moment, all the previous efforts would be wasted.

    But now with this gift of perception...

    He immediately took action, took out the heart of the Tie E Hui Fei from the refrigerator, and cut it into a thin slice.

    Then he picked up the young bloodroot, washed it, put it into a grinder and crushed it separately. Prepared the supplementary materials, utensils and water, and then started to prepare it.

    First, pour the bloodroot powder into clean water. The moment the powder comes into contact with the water, spiritual energy begins to surge.

    In the past, he could only vaguely feel some changes during this process, but now he could very clearly feel the spiritual energy separating from the fibers of the bloodroot and converging towards the center of the liquid.

    Chen Feng stretched out his fingers and hung them above the mouth of the bottle. With the help of his perception ability, he could clearly detect the nodes where the spiritual energy gathered.

    When the spiritual energy surged to its peak, he immediately injected the heart lipid solution that had been processed in advance.

    At the right time, the spiritual energy is neutralized by the active ingredients in the lipids, and the surge subsides instantly.

    The color of the liquid medicine changed from turbid to clear light red, and it was a bit brighter than the bottles that were prepared before.

    The whole process is very silky smooth.

    Operations that used to require concentration and concentration, but were now accomplished with ease.

    Chen Feng picked up the medicine bottle and took a sip.

    The liquid medicine enters the throat and is warm and long-lasting. It is gentler than the medicines prepared before and is absorbed faster.

    "Sure enough..."

    He put down the bottle, his heart burning.

    The profession of spiritual medicine master has a high entry barrier, and the core lies in the perception of the flow of spiritual energy.

    Ordinary elixir masters can only rely on accumulation of experience, trial and error again and again, and slowly explore the rules.

    Only when you have reached a very high level of cultivation and have strong spiritual power can you truly see the flow of spiritual energy.

    But now that Chen Feng has the gift of perception, he skips this process directly.

    With this talent, the learning speed of elixir medicine may be increased several times, and it may not take long before a real first-level potion can be successfully concocted...

    Chen Feng couldn't help but grin.

    After being excited for a while, I suppressed this idea temporarily.

    He turned around and sat back at the table, took out the few martial arts notes he got from the martial arts school from his personal space, and opened them to read.

    The handwriting varies, some are neat and some are scrawled, but the common problem is that they are too scattered.

    Moreover, the focus of each student's records is different.

    Some have written down the essentials of Zhuang Kung Fu, but not the accompanying breathing tips. Some have memorized the names and movements of the moves, but have no corresponding path for exerting force.

    If you bite it hard, you don’t know that you will have to chew it until the year of the monkey.

    Chen Feng closed the note, leaned back in his chair and thought for a while, then opened his phone and took a look at the bank APP.

    During this period, a few more bloodroot plants were sold on Baiyu, and together with the 10,000 yuan in cash given by Sister Zhou Rou, the account balance was 12,000 yuan.

    He hesitated for a few seconds, opened his computer browser, and searched for a keyword.
